result.description:
Casual Timber Yard Labourers – 9-Month Assignment (10 Positions)

Location: South Brisbane, QLD
Commencement: August 2026
Employment Type: Casual (9-Month Assignment)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking 10 reliable and motivated Timber Yard Labourers to join a busy timber manufacturing and pallet processing operation based in South Brisbane.

These casual positions offer consistent full-time hours over a 9-month assignment within an established production environment. Successful applicants will receive comprehensive training, a full site induction and ongoing support from experienced supervisors.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking stable employment in the timber manufacturing industry.

Key Duties

Successful applicants will be responsible for a variety of timber yard and production duties, including:

Repairing damaged timber pallets using hand and power tools.
Assembling new timber pallets to production specifications.
Inspecting pallets and timber products to ensure quality standards are met.
Stacking, sorting, packing and preparing pallets for storage and dispatch.
Loading and unloading timber products and pallets.
Assisting with general timber yard operations.
Supporting production staff with manufacturing activities.
Maintaining a clean, safe and organised workplace.
Following all workplace health and safety procedures.
Performing repetitive manual handling and lifting throughout the shift.
Completing other duties as directed by supervisors.
Essential Selection Criteria

Applicants should demonstrate:

Reliable attendance and a strong work ethic.
Ability to undertake physically demanding manual work.
Ability to repeatedly lift, carry and stack timber products.
Commitment to workplace health and safety.
Ability to work effectively within a team environment.
Good communication skills.
Ability to follow instructions and established work procedures.
Desirable Skills
Previous experience within timber manufacturing, pallet repair, warehousing, manufacturing or general labouring.
Experience using hand and power tools.
Current Forklift Licence (LF).
Experience working within a production or manufacturing environment.
Physical Requirements

Applicants must be capable of:

Standing and walking for extended periods.
Frequent bending, twisting and reaching.
Repetitive lifting and carrying of timber products.
Performing physically demanding manual tasks.
Working around machinery and mobile plant.
Wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times.
3.3.6 Hours of Work, Pay & Conditions
Hours of Work

Successful applicants will generally work:

Monday to Friday
Ordinary Hours: 38 hours per week
Ordinary hours will generally be worked between 7:30 am and 4:00 pm
30-minute unpaid meal break

Reasonable overtime may be required to meet operational requirements and will be paid in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Pay & Conditions

Employment conditions are governed by the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).

Successful applicants will receive:

Minimum casual hourly rate of $33.05 per hour, plus applicable overtime, penalty rates and allowances in accordance with the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
25% casual loading.
Superannuation in accordance with the Superannuation Guarantee legislation.
Weekly payroll with itemised payslips.
All entitlements provided under the National Employment Standards and the Timber Industry Award 2020 (MA000071).
Work Environment

This position is based within a timber processing and pallet manufacturing facility and involves:

Manual handling of timber products and pallets.
Repetitive lifting, carrying and stacking.
Standing and walking for extended periods.
Exposure to timber dust, noise and moving machinery.
Working indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Strict adherence to workplace health and safety procedures.
Wearing mandatory Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants must be able to:

Pass a pre-employment medical assessment.
Pass drug and alcohol screening.
Participate in a site safety induction.
Comply with all workplace health and safety policies and procedures.
Be physically capable of performing the inherent requirements of the position.
Training

Successful applicants will receive:

Full site induction.
